_comment: Battle of the Realm — the one-shot SFX catalogue. Shared source of truth for
tools/generate-sfx.js (which buys them) and tools/trim-sfx.sh (which cuts them).
Every name here is a cue the game already triggers — see the `S` table in
scripts/battle/util.js. Generating one upgrades every call site at once; a cue
you never generate simply keeps its built-in WebAudio synth voice.
`cap` is the trimmed ceiling in seconds. These fire fast and often and several
can overlap, so anything that reads as an impact stays short. Edit a prompt and
re-run with --force to buy a new take.
House style: storybook fantasy, warm and playful, never harsh — this is a
children's game about freeing creatures, not a shooter. Dry and punchy: reverb
tails smear together when cues stack.
Do NOT ask for a quiet sound. Words like quiet, soft, subtle and unobtrusive are
taken literally and come back at a peak of about 0.03, which is inaudible — that
is how the first whoosh and box_open takes were lost. Ask for a present, clear
sound and set how loud it actually plays in the S table in scripts/battle/util.js.

hit.prompt: Cartoon battle impact — a solid meaty thwack with a short low thud underneath, storybook creature duel, punchy and satisfying, completely dry, no reverb tail

splash.prompt: A creature belly-flopping into water — a big cartoon splash with a quick watery gulp and light droplet patter, playful not harsh, short tail

shoot.prompt: Light cartoon projectile launch — a soft airy pew with a quick woody snap of a slingshot releasing, storybook not military, clean and dry, very short

reload.prompt: Quick cartoon reload — a light wooden clack-clack of pouches being refilled, tidy mechanical two-beat, warm and toylike, dry, short

good.prompt: Bright cheerful success blip — a crisp two-note ascending chime, small win confirmation, warm and encouraging, very short and dry

bad.prompt: Gentle cartoon mistake sound — a soft descending two-note wobble, disappointed but kind, never harsh or buzzy, short and dry

star.prompt: Sparkling star pickup — a bright glassy twinkle rising with a light magical shimmer, collectible reward, clean and short, no tail

star_pop.prompt: A single gold star stamping onto a results card — a bright bell ding with a quick sparkle burst and a satisfying soft thump underneath, proud and punchy, arcade results screen, short and dry

combo.prompt: Combo streak ding — an exciting bright digital chime a step higher than the last, rewarding escalation, crisp and very short

heart.prompt: Health fully restored — a warm gentle magical swell rising into a soft glowing chime, comforting and generous, storybook healing, clean, medium-short

tick.prompt: Short dry countdown tick — a clean wooden clock blip, neutral and crisp, tiny, absolutely no tail

go.prompt: FIGHT! countdown release — a bright rising horn-and-chime stab that launches the round, energetic and heroic, punchy, short tail

swipe.prompt: Fast cartoon whoosh — a light airy swish of a creature darting past, soft and clean, short, no reverb

ui.prompt: Crisp UI confirm tap — a light wooden mallet click with a soft warm tone, storybook menu button press, snappy and dry, tiny

ui_back.prompt: Soft UI back tap — a muted low wooden knock with a gentle downward tone, menu cancel or return, quieter and rounder than a confirm, tiny and dry

whoosh.prompt: Airy whoosh sweep — a clear rush of air moving past like a page turned fast, crisp and present, clean, dry, no reverb, short

win.prompt: Short victory jingle — a triumphant ascending major-key flourish with bells and a bright sparkle, a duel won, celebratory, resolves cleanly

lose.prompt: Gentle defeat jingle — a soft descending minor-key phrase, wistful and kind rather than punishing, encourages another try, resolves and ends

region_clear.prompt: A whole region freed from an evil spell — a big warm orchestral-lite fanfare, horns and strings rising over sparkling bells and a triumphant drum roll, spell shattering into light, joyful and emotional, grander than a single duel win, resolves on a full major chord

fanfare.prompt: Regal royal fanfare announcing an evil king — bold brass fanfare with a dark ominous undertow and a deep timpani hit, storybook villain arrival, dramatic

badge.prompt: Achievement unlocked chime — a warm rising bell arpeggio finishing on a bright sparkle, proud and rewarding, clean and short

box_open.prompt: A treasure chest bursting open — a bright pop of ribbon and paper into a full shower of magical sparkles and a warm rising chime, delighted surprise, present and twinkly, medium-short

boss_warn.prompt: Danger telegraph before a boss attack lands — a tense low pulsing warning tone with a quick sharp edge, readable at a glance, urgent but not shrill, dry and short

boss_slam.prompt: A huge boss slamming the ground — a deep heavy whump with a low rumbling boom and a dusty crunch, enormous weight, cartoon-scaled not gory, punchy with a short tail

start.prompt: Big adventure-start chime — a bright confident two-note rise with a warm bloom behind it, the moment a quest begins, storybook fantasy, clean and present, dry

select.prompt: Light selection tick — a small warm marimba blip choosing an item from a grid, pleasant and quick, storybook menu, tiny, dry, no reverb

toggle.prompt: Sound toggle click — a small round wooden switch flicking over, neutral and tactile, tiny, dry, no reverb

log_roll.prompt: A floating log rolling a half-turn underfoot — a short hollow wooden knock with a wet creak, riverside, tactile, dry, very short

orb_pop.prompt: A glowing magic orb popping when tapped — a bright glassy burst with a quick sparkle, clean and satisfying, arcade, very short, no tail

bomb.prompt: Small cartoon bomb going off — a muffled comedic thud-boom with a puff, harmless and silly rather than violent, children's game, dry, short

star_catch.prompt: Catching a falling star in your hands — a soft bright twinkle landing with a warm little chime, gentle and rewarding, clean, very short

blast.prompt: A charged magic blast firing — a deep whoomph releasing into a bright energy burst, powerful and satisfying, storybook special move, punchy, short tail

claw_grab.prompt: A metal claw closing on a prize — a quick mechanical clamp with a light metallic clink, arcade grabber machine, tactile, dry, short

hop.prompt: A light springy hop — a soft bouncy boing with a puff of air, cartoon jump, weightless and cheerful, tiny, dry

dive_slam.prompt: A creature diving down and slamming the ground — a rushing swoop into a solid dusty thud, weighty impact, cartoon-scaled, punchy, short tail

dodge_hit.prompt: A swiping attack connecting with a creature — a quick cloth-and-body whump with a soft ouch of impact, cartoon combat, not gory, dry and punchy

caught.prompt: Caught in the act — a sudden accusing sting, sharp gasp of strings with a dropping tone, playground game of statues, tense but playful, short

flap.prompt: A single wing flap — a soft feathery whoomp of air catching under wings, light and buoyant, clean, very short, no reverb

cloud_pass.prompt: Sailing cleanly through a gap in the clouds — a soft airy swish with a light sparkle of approval, weightless, brief and pleasant

tile_hop.prompt: Hopping onto a stone tile — a light gritty stone tap with a small scuff, tactile, dry, very short

tile_burst.prompt: A floor tile bursting into flame — a sharp crack followed by a whooshing gout of fire, sudden and hot, cartoon hazard, dry, short tail

curl_slide.prompt: A curling stone released across ice — a smooth gliding hiss with a low grinding rumble, long slick slide, clean, no reverb

bullseye.prompt: Landing dead on the bullseye — a crisp bright ding with a triumphant sparkle flourish, precision rewarded, clean and short

rune_1.prompt: A carved stone rune lighting up, lowest of four tones — a warm round mallet chime like a marimba, magical and clear, single soft note, dry, short

rune_2.prompt: A carved stone rune lighting up, second of four rising tones — a warm round mallet chime a step higher, magical and clear, single soft note, dry, short

rune_3.prompt: A carved stone rune lighting up, third of four rising tones — a warm round mallet chime higher again, magical and clear, single soft note, dry, short

rune_4.prompt: A carved stone rune lighting up, highest of four tones — a bright round mallet chime at the top of the run, magical and clear, single soft note, dry, short

paddle_bounce.prompt: A ball bouncing off a paddle — a firm rubbery pock, clean and tight, arcade, tiny, absolutely no tail

brick_break.prompt: A brick shattering — a short crisp ceramic crack with a scatter of debris, satisfying break, dry, no reverb

pedal.prompt: One pedal stroke of a toy trike — a light plastic-and-metal creak with a small ratchet click, comic and childlike, tiny, dry

wail_lock.prompt: Holding a singing note perfectly on pitch — a pure glassy shimmer swelling briefly, ethereal and rewarding, clean, short

strike_green.prompt: A perfectly timed power strike landing — a heavy wind-up whoosh into a solid satisfying thwack, weighty and rewarding, cartoon combat, punchy

draw_signal.prompt: The STRIKE signal in a duel — a single sharp bright alarm ping cutting the silence, unmistakable go-signal, tense, clean, very short

reel_land.prompt: Landing a fish — a wet flapping splash out of the water into a triumphant little chime, playful fishing success, short

rope_jump.prompt: A quick standing jump — a light scuff of feet leaving the ground with a soft whoomp, agile and springy, tiny, dry

rope_pass.prompt: A skipping rope whipping past underfoot — a fast airy whip-swish, rhythmic, clean, very short, no reverb

screech_launch.prompt: A sonic screech launching upward — a piercing rising shriek of compressed air, bird-like and urgent, clean, short

crystal_burst.prompt: A crystal shattering in a burst of sound — a bright glassy explosion with ringing shards, satisfying break, crisp, short tail

slab_thread.prompt: Slipping cleanly through a narrow gap in falling stone — a quick stony scrape rushing past with a relieved swish, near-miss, dry, short

sling_thwack.prompt: A slingshot pellet smacking its target — a sharp elastic-driven thwack into something solid, precise and punchy, dry, no tail

orb_eat.prompt: A creature gulping down a glowing orb — a quick wet swallow with a bright magical blip, gluttonous and cute, tiny, dry

arrow_show.prompt: A direction arrow snapping into view — a crisp short digital tick with a tiny whoosh, alert and clean, tiny, no tail

swipe_ok.prompt: A swipe landing in the right direction — a fast clean slash with a bright confirming ping, decisive, dry, very short

trace_dot.prompt: Passing a finger through a glowing waypoint — a soft glassy bead-tick, delicate and precise, tiny, dry, no reverb

rune_done.prompt: A magic rune completed and flaring to life — a rising magical shimmer resolving on a warm bright chime, a spell breaking, clean, short

tug.prompt: One hard heave on a rope — a short creaking fibre strain with a gritty pull, effortful, tiny, dry

link_snap.prompt: A binding link snapping apart — a taut sharp pop of breaking cord with a bright metallic ring, freeing, crisp, very short
